public totalSumAvailability As Decimal = 0
public totalSumCommitment As Decimal = 0
public totalSumObligation As Decimal = 0
public dictionarySum as New System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary(Of String, String)
Private Sub XrLabel1_SummaryGetResult(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As DevExpress.XtraReports.UI.SummaryGetResultEventArgs) e.Result = totalSumAvailability e.Handled = True End Sub
Private Sub XrLabel1_SummaryRowChanged(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.EventArgs) If Not dictionarySum.ContainsKey(GetCurrentColumnValue("availabilityCode") & "1") Then totalSumAvailability += Convert.ToDecimal(GetCurrentColumnValue("availabilityValue")) dictionarySum.Add(GetCurrentColumnValue("availabilityCode") & "1", GetCurrentColumnValue("availabilityCode")) End If End Sub
Private Sub XrLabel4_SummaryGetResult(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As DevExpress.XtraReports.UI.SummaryGetResultEventArgs) e.Result = totalSumCommitment e.Handled = True End Sub
Private Sub XrLabel4_SummaryRowChanged(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.EventArgs) If Not dictionarySum.ContainsKey(GetCurrentColumnValue("CommitmentCode") & "2") Then totalSumCommitment += Convert.ToDecimal(GetCurrentColumnValue("CommitmentValue")) dictionarySum.Add(GetCurrentColumnValue("CommitmentCode") & "2", GetCurrentColumnValue("CommitmentCode")) End If End Sub
Private Sub XrLabel2_SummaryRowChanged(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As System.EventArgs) If Not dictionarySum.ContainsKey(GetCurrentColumnValue("ObligationCode") & "3") Then totalSumObligation += Convert.ToDecimal(GetCurrentColumnValue("ObligationValue")) dictionarySum.Add(GetCurrentColumnValue("ObligationCode") & "3", GetCurrentColumnValue("ObligationCode")) End If End Sub
Private Sub XrLabel2_SummaryGetResult(ByVal sender As Object, ByVal e As DevExpress.XtraReports.UI.SummaryGetResultEventArgs) e.Result = totalSumObligation e.Handled = True End Sub
